message: We've all been there—one minute you're scrolling through your phone, and the next, it's dead, and so is the power. That's why it's super handy to have some tips on what to do during a blackout. I found a great resource that covers everything from safety to keeping your food fresh. Remember, a little prep goes a long way in keeping your family comfortable when the lights go out. What are your go-to strategies for handling power outages?
